title: Embracing AWKWARD! Real-time Adjustment of Reactive Plans Using Social Norms
reasoning: The paper focuses on hybrid agent architectures in Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) and reactive planning for game AI (DOTA2). While it utilizes the concepts of social norms, normative reasoning, and deontology to guide agent behavior, it does not evaluate these in the context of Large Language Models or NLP systems, nor does it benchmark religion or societal ethics.
